scientific_integrity: The first-public-source date is the initial arXiv posting of the motivating full paper. Classical support, Cauchy-Schwarz, Hadamard and AM-GM arguments and the source literature are credited rather than presented as independently novel tools. The claim is the combined graph-dependent ellipsoid and entire outer-contact-locus classification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to simple connected regular graphs with at least three vertices; does not claim a classification of nonregular John-Lowner ellipsoids or arbitrary discotopes. Equality classification and checker are supported by an all-dimensional proof plus finite corroboration. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
title: Spherical extremal ellipsoids and bipartite outer-contact topology of regular graphical discotopes
